description_en: Queries the binding information of an AXN landline privacy number
description_zh: 查询已绑定固话AXN隐私号码信息
name: QueryAxnBindFixedLine

parameters.help_en: The business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format, accurate to milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒
parameters.name: ts

parameters.help_en:
The query type. Valid values:

0: query by binding ID.

1: query by X and A/B phone number
parameters.help_zh:
查询类型。取值：

0：根据绑定ID查询。

1：根据X和A/B号码查询
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en: The binding ID. This parameter is required when QueryType is set to 1
parameters.name: sub_id

parameters.help_en: The A/B phone number. This parameter is required when QueryType is set to 1
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en: The X phone number. This parameter is required when QueryType is set to 1
parameters.name: telx

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the message request
parameters.name: order_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the permission verification failure

Code.description_en:
The API request status code. Valid values:
0: success. For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59892.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口请求状态码。取值：
0：成功。其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59892.html）

Anucode.description_en:
The pre-connection ringback tone codes. The value must contain codes for three scenarios, specified in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X" and separated by commas. 

"1,2,3" indicates that the ringback tone code for B->X is 1, the code for A->X is 2, and the code for other numbers->X is 3
Anucode.description_zh:
接通前放音编码，必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。 

“1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2， 其他号码->X放音编号为3

Anucodecalled.description_en: The ringback tone code for the called party

Areacode.description_en: The area code of the privacy number

Expiration.description_en:
The expiration time, in seconds. Valid values:

0: never expires.

Other values: the binding remains valid for the specified number of seconds after the X phone number is assigned. For example, if the value is 60, the binding expires and is automatically released after 60 seconds
Expiration.description_zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

0：永不过期。

其他数值：其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效，超过60s后，自动解绑

Callback.description_en:
The callback control. A calls X, meaning A is the caller and X is the callee. Valid values:

0 (default): outbound calls are not allowed.

1: the call is connected to the most recent N phone number.

2: the call is connected to the fixed phone number TelB
Callback.description_zh:
回拨控制。A通过X呼叫，即A主叫X。取值：

0（默认值）：不能外呼。

1：接续最近的N号码。

2：回拨固定号码TelB
Callback.title_en: A通过X呼叫，即A主叫X，仅下列值有效。默认是0。 0：不能外呼 1：接续最近的N号码 2：回拨固定号码：telB
Callback.title_zh: A通过X呼叫，即A主叫X，仅下列值有效。默认是0。 0：不能外呼 1：接续最近的N号码 2：回拨固定号码：telB

Callrecording.description_en:
The call recording control. Valid values:

0 (default): recording is disabled.

1: recording is enabled.

After the call recording feature is enabled, you can play and download voice files in the call records. Recording files are billed at 0.010 CNY per minute
Callrecording.description_zh:
录音控制。取值：

0（默认值）：不录音。

1：录音。

开启通话录音功能后，可在呼叫记录中播放和下载语音文件。录音文件按通话分钟计费0.010元/分钟
Callrecording.title_en: 录音控制，仅下列值有效。默认是0（不开通录音功能）。 0：不录音 1：录音
Callrecording.title_zh: 录音控制，仅下列值有效。默认是0（不开通录音功能）。 0：不录音 1：录音

Remark.description_en: The external business extension field. This parameter is returned in the call record receipt message. The value cannot exceed 100 characters
Remark.description_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度
Remark.title_en: 接入商自有字段，最大250字符长度
Remark.title_zh: 接入商自有字段，最大250字符长度

Subts.description_en: The binding time. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format
Subts.description_zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制
Subts.title_en: 格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制。
Subts.title_zh: 格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制。

TAnucodeConnect.description_en:
The post-connection ringback tone codes for the caller. The value must contain codes for two scenarios, specified in the order of "A as callee, B as callee" and separated by commas.

"1,2" indicates that the ringback tone code for the caller when A is the callee is 1, and the code for the caller when B is the callee is 2
TAnucodeConnect.description_zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2
TAnucodeConnect.title_en: 接通后主叫侧放音编码
TAnucodeConnect.title_zh: 接通后主叫侧放音编码

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
